info.title: RenderLab private generation API
info.description: Invite-only FIBO image beta. Optional Idempotency-Key guarantees owner-scoped request identity only after migration 0034 is applied. Unkeyed clients remain legacy. The header is FIBO-only; non-FIBO keyed requests receive 400 invalid_request.

get.description: Closed-beta capability discovery, with server feature flags emitted only when true.

post.description: Idempotency-Key enables owner-scoped atomic accept: same key/normalized intent returns same job; changed intent is 409. Missing migration fails closed (503), ambiguous acceptance returns 503 Retry-After without releasing any reservation. Retry same key. Without header legacy POST is non-idempotent. No exactly-once provider guarantee. A non-FIBO request with this header is rejected with 400 invalid_request before admission or provider dispatch.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional 16–128 ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_-] opaque, cryptographically random per intended Create submission. Reuse only to retry this exact normalized request. Without migration 0034: 503, no non-idempotent fallback. Different request under same owner/key: 409. No guarantees for absent header. A non-FIBO request with this header is rejected with 400 invalid_request before admission or provider dispatch.

get.summary: Read or reconcile one owner-scoped job
get.description: May trigger bounded owner-scoped reconciliation; no guarantee of background settlement for users who never return.

post.description: 200 when cancelled and 202 while cancellation is pending; repeating a completed cancellation observes the settled status.

post.summary: Retry a failed generation as a new job
post.description: Requires a failed eligible original; creates a new job. Repeated POST can create multiple new attempts; no request idempotency key.

post.summary: Re-run a succeeded generation as a new job
post.description: Requires a succeeded eligible original; creates a new job; repeated calls are not request-idempotent.

GenerationRequest.description: Current FIBO-only input. Structural JSON Schema plus executable parser refinements documented in x-renderlab-semantic-rules. Unknown properties are tolerated except named forbidden sentinels.

prompt.description: Trimmed before validation; at most 8,000 JavaScript UTF-16 code units after trimming and 4,000 Unicode code points for FIBO unless standalone VGL.

alias.description: Optional; defaults to imageN by one-based position

id.description: Opaque owner-scoped source identity; trimmed by runtime parser

vgl.description: JSON object serialized to a bounded non-empty string of <=8,192 Unicode code points; attached aliases only.

negativePrompt.description: Also limited to 8,000 UTF-16 code units; FIBO limit 4,000 Unicode code points.

GenerationCapabilities.description: Availability flags are present only when true; never invent explicit false flags.

x-renderlab-idempotency.request: Optional Idempotency-Key on POST /api/generation/jobs: 16–128 safe ASCII characters, strongly random intent key. After 0034 installed, same owner+key+normalized request returns original job and immutable attempt, mismatch is 409, missing function 503 without legacy downgrade, unknown acceptance conservatively unconfirmed (503). Omitted header retains legacy non-idempotent behavior. Retry and Run Again do not reuse the Create POST key. A non-FIBO request with this header is rejected with 400 invalid_request before admission or provider dispatch.
x-renderlab-idempotency.dispatch: An accepted job uses a durable outbox with bounded per-job replay protection; not exactly-once provider execution.
x-renderlab-idempotency.finalization: Unique output index and owner-return recovery converge on one durable media row; storage writes need not be exactly once.
x-renderlab-idempotency.cancellation: Terminal replay cannot reopen the original job; repeated cancellation observes or rejects it according to status.

x-renderlab-versioning.policy: Major for breaking request/response/status/error semantics; minor for backward-compatible optional fields/endpoints; patch for corrections that do not change behavior. Version is documentation metadata, not a routed /v1 public API.
x-renderlab-versioning.breakingChange: Changing a major version requires explicit engineering approval and separate runtime release qualification.
